name: ali_ios
description: Automatic Landmark Identification in Intraoral Scans (IOS). Detects dental and anatomical landmarks on 3D surface meshes from intraoral scanners for orthodontic and prosthodontic analysis.

parameters.name: dir_models
parameters.description: Folder containing the pre-trained landmark detection models.

parameters.name: lm_type
parameters.description: Types of landmarks to detect (space separated).

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Output folder for landmarks and results.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Path to log file for progress tracking.
